fields.name: TargetValue
fields.evidence: Copied 1:1 into the fade view: Toolkit ecl::FadeResolveSystem::ProcessFadeRequests (EoCClient.dll+0x891A00) does 'view[0..7] = request[0..7]; view[8..0xB] = request[8..0xB]' for each map value, so the request's +0 is the view's TargetValue. Game struct name ecl::StartFadeRequest (macOS HashMap<EntityHandle, ecl::StartFadeRequest>). | first pass: bg3.exe+0x1D6BA20 writes 0 when it inserts / overwrites the map value (value stride 0x10: 'values + index * 0x10').

fields.name: FadeSpeed
fields.evidence: Copied into view +4 (EoCClient.dll+0x891A00); the blend step bg3.exe+0x18DFEC0 uses view +4 as the fade rate per second. | first pass: bg3.exe+0x1D6BA20 writes 0x40800000 = 4.0 (same pair '0, 4.0' that starts ecl::TimelineFadeView0Component in the probe) - probably the fade speed/duration.

fields.name: FadeIn
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1D6BA20: set to '(systemValue == 0)' where systemValue is the bool of ecl::TimelineSystem::FadeRequests[view] (HashMap<EntityHandle, bool> at system +0xA40, Script Extender name) for the same entity.

fields.name: ImmediateFadeIn
fields.evidence: Copied into view +9 (EoCClient.dll+0x891A00); bg3.exe+0x18DFEC0 then sets the current value to 1.0 at once when the view fades back in. | first pass: bg3.exe+0x1D6BA20 writes the same '(systemValue == 0)' value.

fields.name: field_A
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1D6BA20 writes 0. | names pass 2: bg3.exe+0x18DFEC0 ANDs this byte (copied to view +0xA) into byte +4 of the resolved ls::FadingView0/1Component ('*(out + 4) &= view[0xA]', out starts at {1.0, 1}); the meaning of that output byte (FadingView.field_4) was not established. Default 1.

fields.name: _PadB
fields.evidence: not written (keeps the stack byte) - padding

fields.name: field_C
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1D6BA20 writes 1 (low byte of the last dword; the other three bytes keep stack garbage). | names pass 2: Toolkit EoCClient.dll+0x891A00: 'if (request[8] && request.TargetValue == 0 && request[0xC])' it records {1, request[0xA]} in the system map at +0x180 (the 'fully faded out at once' case); not copied into the view.

fields.name: FadeRequests
fields.evidence: Constructor bg3.exe+0x1D77460 zeroes 0..0x80 and runs FUN_1418c2f60 (loop of 2 over 0x40-byte maps); destructor bg3.exe+0x697CD0 = vector destructor (count 2, size 0x40, map destructor FUN_1405c4870 that frees +0x30 and the key set). bg3.exe+0x1D6BA20 (ecl::TimelineSystem, component fetched by FUN_141d43000 whose query is Spec<TimelineFadeRequestsSingletonComponent>) indexes 'view * 0x40 + comp' for view 0..1, inserts with the 8-byte entity key from the system's FadeRequests[view] and writes a 16-byte value. The index is the render view (the fade components come in View0 / View1 pairs). Name taken from the Script Extender member ecl::TimelineSystem::FadeRequests that feeds it.

fields.name: RemoveFadeRequests
fields.evidence: Constructor zeroes 0x80..0xE0; destructor runs the vector destructor (count 2, size 0x30, set destructor) on +0x80. bg3.exe+0x1D6BA20 inserts 8-byte entity handles taken from two queries into +0x80 (first query) and +0xB0 (second query) when the entity is not in the system's FadeRequests map (FUN_140721030(comp + 0x80 / 0xB0, .., &entity)). The system registration lists ecl::timeline::RemoveFadeRequestEntityOneFrameComponent, hence the name (not confirmed). bg3.exe+0x18C2070 clears all four containers each frame.
